verdict.rationale: TaxJar's official Node client lists a `validate` method to "Validate a VAT number", so the product itself offers some VAT ID validation. Nothing describes how it validates, whether it checks official registries in real time, or any cross-border B2B handling. TaxJar also positions itself as built for businesses that only sell in the US, which further limits cross-border scope. missing for 10: evidence of real-time validation against official registries (e.g. VIES), reverse-charge application, cross-border B2B tax calculation documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, B2B cross-border sales are handled correctly — VAT and tax IDs validated against official registries in real time, reverse charge applied when it should be
